pages.title: Fiery Ingot
pages.text: Fiery Blood or Fiery Tears plus an iron ingot. Only fiery metal survives the heat of a launch.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: $(item)Fiery Blood$(): the $(thing)Hydra$() in the Fire Swamp drops 7 to 10. You reach it after the Labyrinth.$(br2)$(item)Fiery Tears$(): the $(thing)Ur-Ghast$() atop the Dark Tower drops 1 to 5.$(br2)One Hydra covers the core.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Twilight bosses drop into a chest where they started. Each lair holds one boss, but every new Fire Swamp or Dark Tower has another. Cannons and autocannons work well on the Hydra's heads.
